elements.text:
Cycle is the app for a study of healthy male and female collegiate athletes. The study looks at whether where you are in your menstrual or hormonal cycle affects your results on concussion baseline and post-injury assessments.


Athletes in the study are in one of three groups: females who naturally menstruate, females who use a form of hormonal contraception (pill, shot, or ring), and males. Only the two female groups use the app.


For 30 days, the app asks you a few short questions each day about your cycle and any symptoms you are having. Your answers help the study team see where you were in your cycle when you were assessed.
